A primitive '''refugee camp''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Virgillia]]'s [[Virgillia's forested moon|forested moon]] in the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], it was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and destroyed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The [[Trooper/Legends|troopers']] [[Death/Legends|murder]] of all the residents of the camp prompted one of the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] present, [[Rannd Delckis]], to defect to the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]], a group that was [[Virgillian Civil War|fighting]] against the Empire-aligned [[Aristocracy]].

==Description==
A small, primitive camp was located on the [[Virgillia's forested moon|forested moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Virgillia]], in the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]]. It was built by [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], many of whom were [[Gender/Legends|women]], [[Youngling/Legends|children]], or wounded. The conditions in the camp were poor.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==History==
[[File:Virgillia-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The refugee camp was located in the Virgillia system.]]
Between [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]]<ref name="25 BBY">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|jediwatch/13228_1.html|Virgillian Jedi Envoy Declared Lost}}, which establishes that the [[Virgillian Civil War]] began two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:2:28," which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]]. Therefore, the war must have begun in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].</ref> and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="4 ABY">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'' states that the [[Virgillian Civil War]] ended shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the Virgillia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was embroiled in a brutal [[Virgillian Civil War|civil war]] between the [[Aristocracy]], which eventually came to be aligned with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> of 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the refugee camp was discovered by an Imperial [[Information broker/Legends|informant]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jarroth]] and the crew of the Imperial [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Stormwind]]'' were sent to investigate the site. Convinced it was sheltering Virgillian Free Alignment fighters, Jarroth ordered [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] the refugees for information by slowly [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] their flesh off their [[Bone/Legends|bones]] with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] set to low power, a technique known as [[The Burning/Legends|the Burning]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

The torture did not produce any intelligence, although it did [[Death/Legends|kill]] several of its subjects. In response to the deaths, the refugees attempted to fight back, only for them all to be killed by the stormtroopers. The attack was the first mission of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Rannd Delckis]], who was a member of the ''Stormwind''{{'s}} landing party. He found the incident so horrifying that shortly thereafter he defected to the Free Alignment.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The refugee camp was mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] guide published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. It was written by [[Kathy Tyers]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />
